notes.title: WE'RE A TIGA AWARDS FINALIST! PLUS, 20% DISCOUNT ALL THIS WEEK!
notes.content:
The finalists for this year's TIGA Games Industry Awards have been announced and A Musical Story has been nominated in the 'Audio Design' category! 

We're in formidable company, with big hitters including Horizon Forbidden West, The Quarry, and Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy also in the running. It's a huge achievement to be recognised in these awards, so massive congratulations to developer Glee-Cheese Studio – it's well deserved!

The awards take place 10th November. You can see the full list of finalists at the TIGA site.

And if you haven't grabbed A Musical Story yet, now's an ideal time as it's on sale all this week with a 20% discount. 

Matt | Digerati

notes.title: A MUSICAL STORY IS OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Is everybody in? The gear's loaded. The band's all here. It's time to hit the road for an unforgettable trip – A Musical Story has launched and is available to download now!

Play music to unlock the memories of guitarist, Gabriel, in a story without words. Follow the highs and lows of the band as they chase their dream of performing at the legendary Pinewood Festival. 

[previewyoutube=J9WSIlZ0iJ0;full][/previewyoutube]
Before you head off to start jamming, some launch day notes:


 A Digital Deluxe Edition is also available (and with a 10% launch discount). It includes the full game, official soundtrack featuring 26 original songs, digital artbook showcasing in-game and unused imagery, and six wallpapers
 For information regarding accessibility features, full details can be found in this accessibility report 
 If you play A Musical Story and would like to leave some feedback, go ahead and drop it here: A Musical Story | Game Feedback
 If you encounter any issues or bugs while playing, please report them in this thread: A Musical Story | Bug Reports
 A Musical Story has also launched on PS4, PS5, Switch, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, iOS, and Android
 If you enjoy A Musical Story, please consider leaving a user review. Every review really helps.


Some review quotes and scores:


 "One of the best rhythm games in recent memory... a work of art" Nintendo World Report (9.5/10)
 "You will instantly forge connections with the protagonist and invest in the story... an unforgettable experience" COG Connected (8/10)
 "A beautiful audio-visual treat... the music is a wonderful blend of psychedelic 70's rock and lo-fi beats and I want more of it" XboxAddict (8.2/10)
 "This short but very sweet experience had me hooked from start to finish" Xbox Tavern (9.2/10)
 "The cooler, arty cousin of genre stalwarts such as Rock Band and Guitar Hero... you’ll feel a buzz of adrenaline each time you smash your solo" Average Joe Gaming (9/10)


Finally, a huge thank you to everyone who has supported A Musical Story on its journey to launch. We hope you enjoy the game! 

Matt | Digerati

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1546100/A_Musical_Story/

notes.title: ACCOLADES AND AWARDS FOR A MUSICAL STORY!
notes.content:
Wanted to share the news that A Musical Story recently received two 'Honorable Mentions' as part of this year's Independent Games Festival Awards. It was recognised in the 'Excellence in Audio' and 'Excellence in Visual Art' categories. 

There were over 400 entries, so for A Musical Story to be shortlisted TWICE is a wonderful achievement and testament to the talents of developer Glee-Cheese Studio. The IGF Awards take place in March as part of GDC 2022. You can find the full list of Finalists and Honorable Mentions here.

And the accolades don't stop there – A Musical Story is a finalist in the 'Best Audio' category at the upcoming Taipei Game Show '2022 Indie Game Awards' (winners will be announced later this month), and at the end of last year it won 'Best Art Direction' at the Indie X Awards. 

Huge congrats to the team at Glee-Cheese Studio!

In other news, we're delighted to say we will be able to confirm a release date for A Musical Story very soon. Stay tuned!

Matt | Digerati
